624:   getFrequentBrokenLinksMessage(brokenPathsMap: BrokenLinksMap): string {

630:       ([pagePath, brokenLinks]) =>

1140:       this.hostPortState.existingProcess = logger.interpolate`code=${command} subdue=${`(pid ${processId})`} in path=${directory}`;

1148:   async choosePort(host: string, defaultPort: number): Promise<number | null> {
1149:     this.hostPortState.host = host;
1150:     this.hostPortState.defaultPort = defaultPort;
1151:     try {
1152:       const port = await detect({
1153:         port: defaultPort,
1154:         ...(host !== 'localhost' && {hostname: host}),
1155:       });
1156:       if (port === defaultPort) {
1157:         this.hostPortState.port = port;
1158:         return port;
1159:       }
1160:       const isRoot = process.getuid?.() === 0;
1161:       const isInteractive = process.stdout.isTTY;
1162:       const message =
1163:         process.platform !== 'win32' && defaultPort < 1024 && !isRoot
1164:           ? `Admin permissions are required to run a server on a port below 1024.`
1165:           : `Something is already running on port ${defaultPort}.`;
1166:       if (!isInteractive) {
1167:         logger.error(message);
1168:         this.hostPortState.port = null;
1169:         return null;
1170:       }
1171:       this.clearConsole();
1172:       const existingProcess = this.getProcessForPort(defaultPort);
1173:       const {shouldChangePort} = (await prompts({
1174:         type: 'confirm',
1175:         name: 'shouldChangePort',
1176:         message: logger.yellow(`${logger.bold('[WARNING]')} ${message}${
1177:           existingProcess ? ` Probably:\n  ${existingProcess}` : ''
1178:         }
1179: 
1180: Would you like to run the app on another port instead?`),
1181:         initial: true,
1182:       })) as {shouldChangePort: boolean};
1183:       this.hostPortState.port = shouldChangePort ? port : null;
1184:       return this.hostPortState.port;
1185:     } catch (err) {
1186:       logger.error`Could not find an open port at ${host}.`;
1187:       throw err;
1188:     }
1189:   }
